verdict.rationale: Morph is an API-first product. Its public API is documented: an OpenAI-compatible base URL at api.morphllm.com/v1, native Anthropic Messages at /v1/messages, and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering 14 paths with live Try-it runners. A community user independently got the OpenAI-compatible endpoint working with their own CLI tool. The OpenAPI probe 404s were at other candidate paths, which does not contradict the spec served from the api-reference path. Missing for 10: a standalone API versioning policy and an API changelog.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1. One API key covers the open-weight chat models and the specialized tools
Claude Code speaks the Anthropic Messages API, which Morph serves natively at `/v1/messages`.
Morph publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Morph API") covering the public surface at api.morphllm.com
